extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: compact airport terminal, hall 32 x 14 m (10.7 m roof crown) with curbside canopy, 27.2 m control tower with glass cab, 11 m jet bridge on the apron side; approx. 39.9 x 33.2 m incl. curb and apron
extras.notes: exterior only (closed building, opaque glazing, no interior); landside faces -Y, apron and jet bridge on +Y; aeroplane pictograms instead of lettering, no brand, no airline livery; no movable parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
